name: qa-payment
description: Payment testing for Stripe, Adyen, PayPal and Braintree sandboxes: test cards, webhooks, subscription billing, refunds, chargebacks and 3DS flows. Includes a payment lifecycle state reference and a review agent (payment-flow-critic) that flags missing idempotency keys and other high-incident payment defects. Distinct from qa-compliance/pci-dss-control-test-author (PCI DSS scope and controls).
